description:
Job Responsibilities: 
 webMethods Developer 
 Candidate will be responsible for creating webMethods processes under the guidance of a webMethods administrator.
 Specific experience or skills required: (2+ years required) 
 - Knowledge of current webMethods releases version 9.0+.
 - Ability to take direction to fulfill customer requirements in a timely manner.
 - Ability to use existing development as examples to base new work off of. 
 - Strong Knowledge of PUB/SUB Pattern.
 - Experience with Performing Capacity Planning and Sizing of various ESB Components.
 - Experience with RosettaNet Module.
 - Experience in Building RosettaNet process models.
 - Strong knowledge of webMethods security/WS-Security.
 - Flow/Java Services experience.
 - XML/SCHEMA and webMethods web services development experience.
 - WebMethods Products Installation Experience in Linux/Unix.
 - IS/Broker Performance Tuning.
 - Legacy Integrations experience.
 - Trading Networks experience.
 Additional experience or skills that would be a plus but not required: 
 - ASP.NET using C#.
 - Oracle PL/SQL.
 The position may require flexible work hours and the ability to work overtime as needed. Must be organized, be able to multi task, and adapt to changing priorities. The successful candidate must be able to work independently with minimal supervision. In additional to the technical skills, the individual will require excellent verbal and written communications skills to interact with key work partners. 
 
 Shift Hours/Days: 1st shift/ 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM / M-F
 
 Length of Assignment: Temp-to-hire
